title: 이별의 말: 헤어질 때 어떤 마음이에요?
objective: By the end, you can use 10 farewell words, such as 헤어지다, 배웅하다, 그립다, 아쉽다 and 섭섭하다, in short sentences. You can also choose the right word to describe how you feel after a goodbye.
summary: Ten words for saying goodbye and talking about the feelings that come after someone leaves.

task.title: Use the farewell words
task.line: Choose, fill in, or put the words in order, using the word list and the form given in brackets.

words.exampleMeaning: Saying goodbye to an old friend is always hard.

words.meaning: to part ways, to say goodbye (also: to break up)
words.exampleMeaning: We said goodbye in front of the subway station.
My roommate leaves for her hometown tomorrow.

words.example: 이사 가기 전에 이웃들에게 작별 인사를 했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Before moving, I said goodbye to my neighbors.
I went to the airport to see my sister off.

words.meaning: to miss, to long for (someone or something far away or in the past)
words.exampleMeaning: Sometimes I miss my friends from university.

words.meaning: to feel sorry that something is over or did not happen
words.exampleMeaning: It's a shame the trip is already over.

words.meaning: to feel a little hurt or let down (by someone close)
words.example: 제 생일을 아무도 기억 못 해서 섭섭했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I felt hurt that nobody remembered my birthday.

words.example: 같이 여행한 추억은 오래 잊지 못할 거예요.
words.exampleMeaning: I won't forget the memories of our trip for a long time.

words.meaning: to keep in touch, to contact
words.exampleMeaning: I'll keep in touch often, even after I go back home.

exercises: Choose the right word: 졸업식이 끝나고 친구들과 교문 앞에서 (헤어졌어요 / 떠났어요).
Choose the word that fits the feeling: ① 비가 와서 기다리던 소풍이 취소됐어요. 정말 (아쉬워요 / 그리워요). ② 제일 친한 친구가 제 결혼식에 안 왔어요. 좀 (섭섭해요 / 그리워요). ③ 외국에 사니까 엄마가 끓여 주신 된장찌개가 (아쉬워요 / 그리워요).
Fill in the blank with 추억, 이별, or 작별 인사: ① 정든 학교를 떠나기 전에 선생님께 ____를 드렸어요. ② 이 사진을 보면 어릴 때 ____이 생각나요. ③ 그 영화는 두 사람의 슬픈 ____ 이야기예요.
Fill in the blank with the verb and form in brackets: ① 다음 주에 회사 동료가 부산으로 ____. (떠나다, -아요/어요) ② 기차역까지 가서 할머니를 ____. (배웅하다, -았/었어요) ③ 서울에 도착하면 바로 ____. (연락하다, -(으)세요)
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 섭섭했어요 / 말도 없이 / 친구가 / 떠나서
answers: ① 아쉬워요 ② 섭섭해요 ③ 그리워요
① 작별 인사 ② 추억 ③ 이별
① 떠나요 ② 배웅했어요 ③ 연락하세요
친구가 말도 없이 떠나서 섭섭했어요. (also: 말도 없이 친구가 떠나서 섭섭했어요.)
